listing.name: Tweaked Transverse Jump
listing.summary: Allows Transverse Jump to coexist with other abilities like Sustained Burn and provides feedback about gravity well origins and transponder status.
listing.aiSummary: Allows Transverse Jump to coexist with other abilities like Sustained Burn and provides feedback about gravity well origins and transponder status.

description:
Description:

Transverse Jump will no longer disable other abilities when activated; Sustained Burn most notably. A message will also be shown telling you what planet a gravity well belongs to when you stop in it and you will be prompted to turn on your transponder if jumping into non-hostile space.

A message will also be shown telling you what planet a gravity well belongs to when you stop in it and you will be prompted to turn on your transponder if jumping into non-hostile space.
aiDescription: Allows Transverse Jump to coexist with other abilities such as Sustained Burn. When stopping in a gravity well, it displays which planet the well belongs to, and prompts the player to activate their transponder when jumping into non-hostile space.
